HPX_SHORTCUTS.py.summary:
Class representing the HP Smart app Shortcuts screen and related dialogs.

This page object provides comprehensive automation support for the Shortcuts feature, including creation, editing, deletion, and execution workflows.

Key Features:
- Inherits from SmartFlow for shared flow logic.
- Locators and methods for all major UI elements and dialogs.
- Consistent use of wait_for_object with configurable timeout and raise_e for robust synchronization.
- Dynamic locator construction for parameterized elements (copies, colors, two-sided options, color cards).
- Clear separation between verification (returns element/boolean) and action (performs click/input) methods.
- Handles Print, Email, and Save destinations with toggle management.
- Form input methods clear fields before entering text.
- Attribute retrieval for state verification (enabled, selected, text).
- Dialog and confirmation message handling for user workflows.
- Swipe gestures for scrolling to elements.
- Exception handling for robust automation.

This class enables maintainable, reusable, and enterprise-grade mobile UI test automation for the HP Smart app Shortcuts feature.
